trimmedBy: none: the body is stored exactly as received (it is not JSON or not worth re-serialising, hence the extension)
notes: A company that does not exist (or has not switched the XML feed on - the two are not distinguishable from outside) answers HTTP 404 with an HTML "Page Not Found" page (2,472 bytes, content-type text/html), stored exactly as received but as .txt: it is evidence of the status and the page, and an HTML file in a fixture directory would be rewritten by the mutation tooling. The tenant is deliberately fictitious. The fixture is the 404 BODY; the adapter never reads it. ENDPOINT: https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language={code} (developer.personio.de: language is one of de, en, fr, es, nl, it, pt "depending on the languages available for the Career Site"; the feed must be switched on per company in Settings > Recruiting > Career page > Activations, support.personio.de). HOSTS: the .de and .com hosts served byte-identical documents for both tenants tried (sha256 equal), so they are aliases of one data set, not two regions. NO POSTING URL IS IN THE FEED; the posting page is https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/job/{id} (measured for westwing: HTTP 200, canonical https://westwing.jobs.personio.de/job/2814781?language=en; the personio tenant's own position 1834171 answered 404 on the same pattern). robots.txt of personio.jobs.personio.de: "User-agent: * / Allow: /". The docs state no rate limit or terms of use. A language the feed does not carry is NOT an error: language=xx answered the same 45,529 bytes as language=de, and the document without a language parameter equals language=en.
